annotations.title: Embed code for a living 3D scene, in a brand's colours

description: Returns paste-ready code for a CSS Crème Scene: an interactive 3D meadow (four seasons, dandelion clocks, or a garden of peonies, white roses, lilies, irises, hydrangeas, tulips or daffodils, at any hour) grown by code in the browser, with no models or images to load. Give it the `roles` (and optionally `colors`) from a decode_url result and the three flowers take that site's declared colours, each with its source named; or pass a `palette` of hex values. It reads no URL itself. Returns the <creme-scene> element, an iframe, a full-screen link and the licence line. Free to embed with the visible credit.

colors.description: Optional: the colors array from decode_url, used when roles alone hold fewer than three strong colours.

mode.description: background sits the scene behind a section's own content.

palette.description: Optional explicit colours: { a, b, c, grass, sky, light } as #hex. Wins over roles.

roles.description: The roles object from decode_url (primary, accent and so on). The flowers take its strongest declared colours.

time.description: Hour of the day, 0 to 24. 9 is morning, 18.5 golden hour, 22 night. Default 16.2.

name: get_scene_embed
